rows.en:
Then she vanished, as if swallowed up by that light.
Where she had stood, the mask she'd been wearing lay where it had been gently set down.{p}

I looked out the window.
The long night was over, and a soft light enveloped everything.
"Mmmmh..."
I gave a big stretch.
Somehow, I felt I could write a good article.
But how was I going to explain that the people who'd told me scary stories had disappeared?
...There was no need to think about it.
I'd just have to write honestly about what I had experienced.
Because it was something even I couldn't explain.
I turned around and started to leave the restroom.{p}

...Something was wrong.
The mask that had been lying right there a moment ago was gone.
There shouldn't be anyone here but me, so there was no way it could have disappeared.
I had a bad feeling.
The morning sun that had been shining in was weaker now, as if the sun had gone behind a cloud.
I hurried to get away from the restroom.
I felt as if a foul air, or rather a spiritual aura, had begun to drift in.
And a deeply evil aura at that...
I rushed out of the restroom.{p}
I tore down the hallway and raced down the stairs so fast I was practically tumbling.

Someone was chasing me from behind!
I knew there was no one here but me.

But I could definitely sense someone chasing after me.
I was too scared to look back.
I could sense that something truly terrifying was chasing me from behind.{p}
It was right behind me now!

I could hear them breathing!
(Wait, wait for me, {a}...)
(Hold it, {a}...)
I heard Hosoda's and Shindo's voices inside my head.
(It's those six! The ones chasing me are those six☆)
(Where do you think you're going?)
(You can't escape from us, you know.)
(Honestly, you just don't know when to give up...)
(Come on, why don't you just give in?)

"Waaaaaaah☆"
I ran with my hands over my ears.{p}

"Ugh..."
I had fallen down the stairs.
I tried to get up, felt a searing pain in my leg, and collapsed.
(M-my leg...)
My leg was broken, bent at an angle from the shin.
I couldn't see it under my trousers, but it seemed the bone was sticking out.
The blood pouring out had pooled on the floor like a puddle.
Throb. Throb. A pulsing pain shot through me.{p}

(Heh heh heh, we've finally caught up with you.)
(Come on, {a}. Come with us.)
When I looked up, I saw what seemed to be Shindo and Iwashita standing right in front of me.
Both of them were wearing masks over their faces.{p}

({a}, I always thought you and I got along.
Let's stay close forever. We're friends, after all.)
When I looked back, Hosoda and the others were standing there in masks.{p}(Come on, let's go...)
Iwashita was holding out her hand.
Take her hand
Refuse

I took her hand.
Iwashita slowly pulled me up.
I managed to stand, but strangely, I felt no pain in my leg.
I had a sensation of floating, so I looked down at my feet.{p}

And there was my body, lying there.
Its face had gone pure white. It was nothing like the face of a living person.
(I see... I'm dead...)
Strangely, I was able to accept that fact without resisting.
..............................{p}

Before I knew it, I was standing in that restroom again.
One by one, they all went into the second stall from the back.
I went in too, as if I were being drawn inside.
(Ah, now I'm the one who'll become a school rumor...)
When I thought that, I strangely felt a sense of pride.
I realized that at some point, that mask had been fitted onto my face too.{p}
And then the restroom door closed...{p}

...I didn't lay a hand on the ones who drove me to my death.
Instead, I thought I'd be saved by driving their children to their deaths.
I felt that doing so would wash my ugly, twisted heart clean.
Is that cruel?
...Do you think I'm cruel?
Heh heh heh, think whatever you like.
...But remember this much.
When you commit a sin, you won't necessarily be the one who pays for it.
Your sins may come back to make you pay in ways you never expected.
And when that happens, it'll be too late for regrets.
But it doesn't matter anymore.
None of it...
I've achieved my goal, but I don't think I need to be saved anymore.
...I never thought that even in this state, a heart just like a human's would grow in me.
Just as those children came to enjoy bullying.
And just as it became a habit for them.
I've come to enjoy plunging people into the depths of terror.
Yes, you can find pleasure in anything at all.
It's a real problem, isn't it?
So I've decided to go on like this, chasing nothing but my own pleasure in this school.
Don't worry.
I won't do anything to you.
You're a good person.
I can tell...{p}

She turned her back to me.
Then she opened the window and gazed up at the eastern sky, where dawn was beginning to break.
What expression was she wearing behind her mask?
She put her hands to her mask once more.
This time, without hesitating, she slowly took it off.{p}

Then she gazed up at the sky again.
...If I could have lived in the same time as you, I'm sure we'd have been good friends...
I thought I heard her murmur that.
Then she slowly turned around to face me.{p}

"★"
Then dozens, hundreds of butterflies burst out of her face.
The butterflies flew around me, circling me on every side.
That many butterflies would normally seem creepy, but oh, how dreamlike it was...
They were blue butterflies, unlike any I had ever seen.
The butterflies danced in the morning sunlight.
Then, all at once, they flew out the window.{p}

I didn't know what to say.
But revenge was wrong.
I understood how she felt, too.
But they hadn't had anything to do with it directly, had they?
That was what I thought.
"Heh heh heh heh... I told you at the start, didn't I?
That I know what you're thinking.
Yes.
That's right.
They had nothing to do with it.
The ones to blame are their parents, not them.
But my revenge is over.
It's too late.
By killing their children, I'm giving them a taste of the grief my parents went through.{p}So, do you think this has saved me?"
I think you've been saved
There's no way you'll be saved

I see. Thank you.
You really do mean that.
...But you know, I already understand.
Doing this won't save me.
Revenge doesn't solve anything.
It only creates new people who can't be saved...
Even so, this was the only thing I could do.{p}

As she said that, she quietly looked back over her shoulder.
"Ah..."
Six new figures appeared behind her.
The people who had gathered for the newspaper club.
People who had been alive only a few hours ago.
People who now showed not the faintest pulse of life.
All of them had hollow eyes and were looking down at the floor.{p}

"Look, more new companions have been born.
Now I won't be lonely anymore...
But I suppose they must hate me.
And their hatred for me will twist my heart..."{p}
With that, she gently laid her hand on the mask.{p}"I'll ask you once more. Don't you want to see my face?"
I want to see it
I don't want to see it

I see. You really want to see it that badly?
...You might regret it, you know.{p}And you're fine with that...?
I won't regret it
I don't need to see it after all

I see.
You're braver than I thought.
Very well.
I'll show you... my heart.
She gently took off the mask.{p}

I didn't even have time to regret it.
It seemed I had died too.
The moment she took off her mask, a tremendous flood of emotion poured into me...
My heart hadn't been able to bear it.
That sorrow, that agony.
Is that how you end up feeling when you go on hating people for so long...?
But now, I feel as if I understand.
The heart of someone whose life was taken from them halfway through.{p}

She killed herself.
But the ones who killed her were the parents of those six.
She was murdered.
She was robbed of her life.
A hatred far beyond anything the living could ever imagine.
There must have been so much she still wanted to live for and do.
And she was robbed of it.
Maybe that bitter regret turns straight into hatred.
..............................{p}

I too had lost my life halfway through.
What about me?
Do I feel that bitter regret too?
And will I go on resenting someone too?
I don't understand my own heart.
Someday, I might become like her.
...And what about those six...?{p}

...I never laid a hand on the people who drove me to my death.
Instead, I'll be saved by driving their children to death.
I feel as if doing that will wash my ugly, twisted heart clean.
Is that cruel?{p}...Do you think I'm cruel?
That's not true!
You are cruel

"No. You're not cruel..."
For some reason, that was the answer I gave.
...Thank you.
Now I have nothing left to regret.
Whether I pass on from here or fall into hell, it doesn't matter anymore.
You don't seem to quite understand what I mean by being saved.
Being saved isn't about my soul.
Even though I died and am no longer of this world, my heart still remains.
It's that heart, my own heart, that will be saved.
Now, it's time...
I listened to her in silence.{p}

She turned back to face me.
And this time, without asking me, she took off the mask.{p}

Behind her mask....................
was a face so beautiful that words could never describe it.
Translucent white skin and pale pink cheeks.
And large, dark eyes that looked straight into mine...
Those eyes were so deep and clear that they showed no trace of doubt or worry.
The face looked at me and smiled.
I never once looked away from those eyes.{p}

Behind it lay a darkness, black and deep.
I felt as if I were about to be sucked into that darkness.{p}

The clatter of the mask hitting the floor brought me back to myself.
Even as her face changed, I had been able to watch it all without flinching.
She was neither a ghost nor a monster.
That was her heart...
When the mask fell to the floor and rocked, she was already gone.{p}

"You are cruel! That's no excuse for driving their children to their deaths! It's the lowest thing you could do!"
I shouted, furious.
...I see. So you say that kind of thing about me too.
No one understands my bitterness.
The only ones who grieved when I died were my father and mother.
I died with a powerful attachment to this world, and so here I am.
My heart given form, a being that can't truly exist...
But fine.
It's fine!
The six are already dead.
I'll be saved☆
She put her hand to the mask again.
This time, without hesitating, she took the mask off.{p}

Behind her mask....................
was a face so beautiful that words could never describe it.
Translucent white skin and pale pink cheeks.
And large, dark eyes that looked straight into mine...
Perhaps this was the face she had when she felt fulfilled.
I stood dumbstruck by her beauty.{p}

...At that moment.
A change came over her face.
Her beautiful face crumbled away like running wax.
Behind that melting face was another face.
That face had skin like a lizard's, dark and murky.
And big, round red eyes were staring at me.
"Still... not... saved...? Still... not... enough...?"
Her voice had changed into a low, muffled drone, like a stretched-out tape.
Only when she spoke did I see that a huge mouth split her face open from forehead to chin.
That mouth was lined with sharp fangs.
"You... too... will become... food... for my... salvation!"
With that, she lunged at me.{p}

The vertical mouth on her face split wide to the left and right and clamped down over my whole head.
Her fangs were buried deep in my head.
Hot blood ran down my face.
She doesn't know.
...She doesn't understand.
That no matter how much you hate someone, taking revenge accomplishes nothing.
It might calm her feelings, but there's no way it can save her.
Let alone let her pass on, doing things like this.
And she will go on repeating the same thing for the sake of her own desires.
Never to be saved, for all eternity...
I die for the sake of her desire, a desire that can never be fulfilled.{p}

As she said that, she quietly looked back over her shoulder.
"Ah..."
Six new figures appeared behind her.
The people who had gathered for the newspaper club.
People who had been alive only a few hours ago.
People who now showed not the faintest pulse of life.
All of them had hollow eyes and were staring down at the floor.
"My new companions. Companions who will be with me forever, for all eternity.
I'm sure we won't have anything to talk about.
But you know, that's fine.
To me, they're a kind of proof that I took my revenge on their parents.
They can't defy me.
They're my faithful dolls.
I'll use them to gather more companions.
To start with... I'll have them make you one of my companions."
With that, she smoothly raised her right hand.
Sensing I was in danger, I bolted out of the restroom.{p}

"Whoa!"
Somehow, Shindo was standing outside the restroom.
I tried to shove him aside and get away.
I slammed into him with my shoulder as hard as I could.{p}

"☆"
I passed right through Shindo's body, and my momentum sent me sprawling.
I hurried to get up, but Shindo pinned me down.
The other five had surrounded me too.{p}

"Hey, {a}. You just don't know when to give up, huh?
That's not very manly.
Call it a samurai's mercy. I'll let you choose who kills you.
So, who's it gonna be?"
(Honestly, what an annoying question.
If I'm going to be killed, I just want whoever it is to do it in one go.)
I found myself thinking such stupid things.{p}"Come on, hurry up and choose..."
Akemi Iwashita
Nozomu Kazama
Shoji Arai
Makoto Shindo
Reiko Fukuzawa
Tomoharu Hosoda

Iwashita licked her lips with delight.
"All right, everyone, hold him down."
Shindo gave the order.
They all held me down firmly so that Iwashita could kill me more easily.{p}

"{a}, the time has finally come for me to kill you.
...If only I had been able to kill you back then, maybe I wouldn't have been possessed by an evil spirit..."
As she said it, Iwashita's face looked like an evil spirit itself.
Iwashita had to be truly possessed by an evil spirit.
"Now, are you ready?
I like you...
But only because you chose me... that is."{p}

Blood sprayed from my throat.
Iwashita's uniform was stained red.
But my eyes could no longer see color.
And then I couldn't even see light anymore.{p}

I see.
Of course...
There's nothing interesting about seeing my face.
But you do want to see it a little, don't you?
I can tell.
What you're thinking.
But I won't show it to you this time.
People often say one thing and think another, after all.
With that, she took her hand away from the mask.{p}
